items.html: And the reason of the matter is as is known: that in Atik, his Hesed is called Yomam, because all the ZAT are included in it. And the clothing of the Hesed of Atik is in the skull of Arich Anpin, as is known. And those seven inclusions of lights in that Hesed were clothed there, in the seven of the skull of Arich Anpin. And also the Yesod of Atik is called Kol, and it has in it the inclusion of all the ZAT; and keep these inclusions. And these seven in the Yesod are drawn from the seven in the Hesed, in the secret of the Hesed that dwells in the mouth of the member; and these seven lights of the Yesod of Atik are clothed in the seven of the skull of ZA.
